description: Theoretical and mathematical foundations of artificial neural networks, learning dynamics, architectures, and attention mechanisms.

topics.title: Biological Inspiration and Artificial Neuron Model
topics.description: Biological soma, dendrites, axon, and synapses mapped to weights, summation, and activation functions.

topics.title: Vectors, Matrices, Dot Products and Derivatives
topics.description: Vector spaces, dot products as projections, matrix transformations, partial derivatives, and gradients.

topics.title: McCulloch-Pitts Neuron and Hebbian Learning
topics.description: First computational neuron model (1943), threshold logic, and Donald Hebb's associative learning rule.
subtopics: Hebb's postulate: neurons that fire together wire together

topics.title: Perceptron Convergence Theorem and Limitations
topics.description: Frank Rosenblatt's perceptron (1958), error-driven weight update, margin of separation, and Novikoff theorem.
subtopics: Novikoff's theorem upper bound on mistakes

topics.title: Linear Separability and the XOR Problem
topics.description: Hyperplane separation criteria, XOR logic truth table geometry, and necessity of multilayer networks.
subtopics: Definition of linear separability in R^n

topics.title: Non-linear Activation Functions and Saturation
topics.description: Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, ELU, SELU, Swish, GELU: asymptotic behavior, zero-centered outputs, and gradient saturation.

topics.title: Layer-by-Layer Matrix Multiplications and Biases
topics.description: Batch tensor representations, linear affine transformations, broadcasting biases, and layer caching.

topics.title: Convexity, Non-Convex Error Surfaces and Minima
topics.description: Loss landscapes: convexity vs non-convexity, local minima, plateaus, ravines, and high-dimensional saddle points.
subtopics: High-dimensional saddle points and escaping ravines

topics.title: Jacobians, Gradients and Computational Graphs
topics.description: Chain rule over matrix tensors, vector-Jacobian products, calculating dL/dW and dL/db, and reverse accumulation.

topics.title: Epochs, Batches, Iterations and Convergence Criteria
topics.description: Training loops: mini-batch selection, epoch definitions, gradient noise, learning rate scheduling, and convergence diagnostics.
subtopics: Training loss vs validation loss curves

topics.title: Zero, Random, Xavier/Glorot and He Initialization
topics.description: Variance propagation analysis, breaking symmetry, Xavier normal/uniform, and He Kaiming initialization.

topics.title: Newton-Raphson, Conjugate Gradient and L-BFGS Concepts
topics.description: Curvature information: Hessian matrix, Newton's method, Quasi-Newton approximations (BFGS, L-BFGS), and scalability limits.
subtopics: O(N^2) memory and O(N^3) inversion bottlenecks

topics.title: Encoder-Decoder Architecture and Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: Unsupervised feature learning, bottleneck compression, reconstruction loss, undercomplete vs overcomplete autoencoders.
subtopics: Relationship between Linear Autoencoders and PCA

topics.title: RBF Networks and Gaussian Kernels
topics.description: Radial Basis Function (RBF) networks, Gaussian receptive fields, center selection, and local vs global representations.
subtopics: Radial basis function definition phi(||x - c||)
Two-stage training: clustering centers + linear regression

topics.title: Hopfield Networks, Energy Functions and Boltzmann Machines
topics.description: Recurrent associative memory, Lyapunov energy functions, spurious states, and stochastic Boltzmann machines.
subtopics: Symmetric weights and zero diagonals (w_ij = w_ji, w_ii = 0)

topics.title: Self-Attention Mechanism, Query-Key-Value and Transformer Intro
topics.description: Dot-product attention, Query, Key, Value matrices, multi-head attention, and transformer self-attention blocks.
